name: pg-management
description: PG Management — multi-branch paying-guest operations platform, delivered as one adaptive Android APK.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
